Comedian Theo Von returns to Joe Rogan for episode 2478. Von's southern tales and strange logic made him a podcast star. His show This Past Weekend draws millions of fans.

Rogan lets Von riff on childhood, fame, and his wild mind. Each story bends in ways no writer could plan. The pair share real warmth under the jokes. The episode is a fan feast: two close friends, one of a kind guest, and a talk that wanders exactly where it wants, to the crowd's delight. His odd mind is the whole draw here.
